# Studio Thesis

What this studio looks for. Filled in by the venture-scout from the stakeholder's answers at studio setup; the values below are defaults until then. Every agent reads this file before acting.

Last updated: <date>, by <stakeholder interview | defaults>

## Focus
- Industries and problems: software and AI tools that save businesses time or money
- Customer type: small and medium businesses, professionals (B2B or prosumer)
- Avoid: regulated products (medical, financial advice, legal services, gambling, adult), hardware, products that need a licence to sell
- Markets: global, English-speaking customers first

## Business model
- Preferred: subscription software
- Acceptable: usage-based pricing, one-time sales of digital products
- Not wanted: marketplaces that need both buyers and sellers before they work, services that need staff
- Revenue goal: UNKNOWN

## Budget and time
- Validation budget per venture: 0 USD (desk research and free tools only)
- First-year running budget per venture: UNKNOWN
- Stakeholder time per venture: UNKNOWN hours per week
- Currency for reports: USD

## Unfair advantages
- Domain expertise: UNKNOWN
- Audience or network: UNKNOWN
- Data or existing business: UNKNOWN
- Build capacity: an AI Scrum Team (ai-scrum-team) that can build web software

## Discover defaults
- Ideas generated per sourcing run: 10
- Ideas shortlisted for research: 3
